compliance.hefsp_status: adopted (original June 24, 2025; Amended HEFSP adopted March 10, 2026)

notes: Alpine has effectively no Fourth Round RDP (VLA gives zero). The DCA prospective need of 257 is reduced to 0 by the 20% cap rule and VLA; the HEFSP states 117 units as the Borough's obligation from its binding resolution. The original June 2025 HEFSP was challenged by FSHC; a mediation agreement dated December 17, 2025 required preparation of an Amended HEFSP (adopted March 10, 2026). The sole active Fourth Round obligation is 4 remaining units from the Third Round (accessory apartment carryover), to be addressed by expanding the existing 100% affordable housing site off Route 9W with 2 additional family units + 2 additional bedrooms. No new inclusionary overlay or redevelopment sites for Round 4 — the plan is entirely unmet-need-based (mandatory set-aside + development fees) plus the 4-unit 3rd Round carryover on the existing 100% affordable site. Candidate snapshot's four sites were all Third Round carryover items; the Fourth Round HEFSP itself has only the 100% affordable site expansion plus unmet need mechanisms with no specific parcels. NOTE: The pre-OCR file was the Planning Board adopting resolution, not the HEFSP; fetched real HEFSP which shows Alpine's genuine Round 4 posture.

sites.adoption_status: proposed; agreement with Bergen County United Way; contingent on septic capacity
sites.source_page: Page 30-31, Section IV Fair Share Plan
sites.quote: Alpine proposes to address its remaining 3rd Round housing obligations through expansion of the existing 100% affordable housing site off of Route 9W in the southerly portion of the municipality. The plan calls for the construction of two (2) additional family apartments and two additional bedrooms.
sites.notes: Carries over 4 unmet units from Round 3 (accessory apartment program that was not realized). The existing Prior Round 8-unit site receives 2 additional family apartments + 2 additional bedrooms. If septic capacity is insufficient, Borough commits to identify alternate site within 120 days of NJDEP decision. Block/lot not stated in HEFSP. This is the only Fourth Round site with specific unit obligations — the 117-unit RDP is zero and all prospective need is unmet need addressed only by mandatory set-aside ordinance and development fees with no specific parcels.
